claim: Blind resampling beat bare-code retry by 18 net unlocks, and code-plus-facts tied blind resampling at the pooled level (26 unlocks each) for 0.5B-1.5B frozen code models.
stance_target: execution-feedback repair is not better than matched-budget resampling for small models
scope_conditions: three 0.5B-1.5B models; 290 dead task-cell units; 7,000 fresh generations plus 1,400 follow-up
quoted_support: Blind resampling exceeded bare-code retry by +18 net unlocks (discordant 25/7, Holm-adjusted p = 0.0021).

breadth.confidence_families: not present (searched: confidence, calibrat, uncertain, verbal; only 'verbal self-critique' in discussion)
breadth.model_families_and_sizes: qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, qwen2.5-coder:0.5b-instruct, deepseek-coder:1.3b served via Ollama (Sec 3 population)
breadth.elicitation_formats: feedback-packet arms: bare code, executed facts, code plus facts, placebo bullets (Table 1 arms)
breadth.benchmarks: HumanEval+ (164) and MBPP+ (365 after 13 loader exclusions)
breadth.label_source: EvalPlus public tier plus prompt-hidden Iplus tier; true unlock requires both
breadth.label_independence: prompt-hidden tier not shown to any arm
breadth.contamination_split: not present (searched: contaminat); prompt-hidden tier split instead
breadth.calibration_metrics: not present; outcome is net unlocks with discordant-pair Holm-adjusted tests
breadth.granularity: task-level unlock; facts are violated I/O examples (up to 6)
breadth.causal_intervention: yes for feedback content: placebo-mirrored arms, matched budget, preregistered (not an intervention on confidence)

claim: Executed-fact content gave +15 over a same-code generic-bullet placebo, but the direction changed in a small disjoint sample.
stance_target: L4/L3 repair-versus-regeneration: partially occupied with placebo controls
scope_conditions: same units; surface-form not fully ruled out
quoted_support: a +15 advantage over the same-code generic-bullet placebo supported the contribution of executed fact content (Holm-adjusted p = 0.0041)
